qualificationReuse.rationale: The retained reviews cover reconnect, authentication, model selection, stock-view classification, and stack isolation. The candidate review limits reuse to unchanged four-stack behavior and records focused controls for changed port admission, native authentication, contract lint, and transport diagnostics. Supabase remains outside this calibration. The notification review replaces all three affected checks and validates unchanged capture outcomes with safer diagnostics. The capture review replaces nine affected checks and preserves unchanged outcomes for the bounded body-drain and safe diagnostic changes. The role-check review replaces affected role checks and both changed reference sources; no prompt change. Reviewed catalog-only contract clarification and GET ordinary-reload capture; affected catalog and Mongo profile controls replaced. Exact task-text mappings do not excuse changed scenarios. The navigation review replaces 79 changed checks and retains 33 unchanged checks; runtime equivalence is limited to safe receipt propagation. The native-auth proxy review retains unchanged registered paths and adds positive, defective and saved-app evidence for arbitrary same-origin proxy prefixes; only SpacetimeDB executable targets change. The readiness review replaces the PostgreSQL external-stock control, validates native interface layouts and selected-route preflight, and maps the two reviewed contract clarifications to unchanged fixed-app scenarios. Module-layout review proves the corrected native re-export admission through saved-source reset/account grading, preserves rejected malformed layouts, and retains unchanged fixed-app checks. Count-observation review proves bounded redraw tolerance, retained missing/duplicate/late rejection, native saved-app conservation, and intended defect catches. Null visibility behavior is unchanged despite the changed shared executable closure. Signup review replaces all three affected keys and validates one separate sign-in without retrying registration or concealing refusal. Retained reference/mutation/null paths use exact executable mappings and unchanged source-slice validation. Catalog/support review replaces ten affected checks. Exact source mappings retain only 102 unchanged keys after reviewed support-only reference edits. The new support receipt is an explicit future grading interface, not a historical score equivalence. Notification/auth/body/number review replaces three changed notification scenarios plus selected PG/Mongo credential and PG numeric controls. Exact source and task transitions preserve only unchanged model-free behavior; the account hook requirement applies prospectively. Entry-navigation review replaces90 changed checks (86 original navigation slices plus4 corrected staff-role slices) and retains22 unchanged fixed-reference checks with exact reviewed task-text pairs. Existing executable mappings remain unchanged; future requests are not historical score equivalents.
